title: proof_verify input
description: Request envelope for re-verifying a receipt (catalog shape `VerifyResult`; mirrors the `receipt_verify` tool arguments). Advertise-only per RCX Session-Handshake v1; the field set is open (additive).

receipt_id.description: Identifier of the receipt to re-verify.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope of the receipt. Defaults to the daemon's default tenant.
